about_item: ALL-IN-ONE COMPLETE DOG GROOMING KIT. Keep your furry friend looking salon-fresh at home. This professional 5-piece dog grooming kit includes a premium Slicker Brush, Undercoat Rake, Silicone Bath Brush, Stainless Steel Metal Comb, and Flea Comb. Designed for brushing, deshedding, detangling, bath time, and coat maintenance, it provides everything needed to keep long, curly, wavy, or double coats healthy, clean, and tangle-free—ideal for both dogs and cats.

UPGRADED UNDERCOAT RAKE FOR EFFORTLESS DETANGLING. Say goodbye to stubborn mats and expensive grooming appointments. The heavy-duty undercoat rake features dual-sided stainless steel teeth that help loosen tangles, remove trapped loose undercoat, and reduce shedding with less pulling. Designed for thick, high-maintenance coats, it helps make routine grooming faster, easier, and more comfortable for your pet.

PERFECT FOR DOODLES & LONG-HAIRED BREEDS. Specially designed for Goldendoodles, Labradoodles, Poodles, Bernedoodles, and other long-haired, curly-coated, or double-coated dogs, as well as long-haired cats. The high-density slicker brush features long stainless steel pins that reach deep into dense fur to remove loose hair, fluff the coat, and help prevent future matting, giving your pet a fuller, cleaner, and well-groomed appearance between salon visits.

SOOTHING BATH BRUSH FOR DEEP CLEANING & MASSAGE. Turn bath time into a relaxing grooming experience. Made with soft, flexible silicone bristles, the bath brush helps distribute shampoo evenly while gently cleaning the skin and coat. It also helps lift away loose wet fur during washing and provides a soothing massage that many pets enjoy, making bath time easier for both dogs and owners.

PRECISION FINISHING COMBS & COMFORTABLE CONTROL. The stainless steel metal comb is ideal for finishing, fluffing, and detailing around the face, ears, legs, and paws, while the flea comb helps with close grooming checks. Designed for professional groomers and pet parents alike, every tool features an ergonomic anti-slip grip that provides better control and helps reduce hand fatigue during longer grooming sessions.

authors_reviews.title: Very useful dog grooming kit for dogs with long hair and undercoats
authors_reviews.text: The dog grooming kit arrived quickly. It was packaged well and was delivered without any damage.I have an 85 lb. Bernese Mountain Dog/Australian Shepherd mix that has long hair and an undercoat. Baxter requires a lot of grooming time to keep all his hair brushed and loose hair removed to keep him clean and healthy. With a double coat, he needs brushed out on top and also an undercoat rake to get the loose undercoat hair out. I got this little kit because it seemed to have everything I needed for daily brushing to keep him groomed and me sane from dealing with loose hair everywhere in my house.The grooming kit includes a slicker brush, undercoat rake, bath brush, metal comb, and flea comb. All the pieces seem to be well-made and high quality. I used the undercoat rake first to try to remove all the loose hair and filled up a huge grocery shopping bag with all the hair. I then used the slicker brush to groom and shine his outer coat. They both worked perfectly and Baxter seemed relaxed while I did it. I plan on using the bath brush the next time I bathe him. It is a soft plastic with ridges (almost like a loofah sponge) and will be gentle on him while helping deep-clean his coat. The metal comb and flea comb are also very sturdy and useful.I found the undercoat rake and slicker brush to be extremely effective at removing loose hair and any small tangles as you cannot ignore the extra needs that longer-haired dogs with undercoats have on a daily basis. Your floors and house will thank you, too. I think the price for all the high-quality tools that you get is extremely affordable when comparing with what a groomer would cost.Pros: High quality, very sturdy and durable, slicker brush and undercoat rake extremely effective, and groomer kit is very affordable.Cons: NoneI love this grooming kit for my dog, Baxter. These will be essential for me keeping all the loose hair off of him and will help him be cooler this summer as it noticeably makes him look thinner when all the extra hair is removed. He was relaxed the entire time I brushed him and even seemed to enjoy the grooming session. I highly recommend, especially if you have a long-haired dog.
authors_reviews.author: William Ball

authors_reviews.title: Complete Grooming Kit with Excellent Quality
authors_reviews.text: I was very happy with this grooming kit. It includes all the essential tools needed to keep a dog’s coat clean, healthy, and tangle free. Having everything in one set makes grooming at home much easier and more convenient.Each tool feels sturdy and well made. The slicker brush works well for removing loose fur and small tangles, while the undercoat rake helps reduce shedding without pulling excessively. The metal comb is great for finishing and checking for knots, the bath brush is comfortable to use during shampooing, and the flea comb is useful for detailed grooming around the face and ears.The handles provide a comfortable grip, and the tools are easy to clean after use. The violet color is also a nice touch and makes the set look attractive.Pros:* Complete 5 piece grooming set.* Durable, quality tools.* Helps remove loose hair and tangles.* Comfortable, easy to grip handles.* Suitable for long-haired and double coated dogs.* Great value for the quality.Cons:* I haven’t found any drawbacks so far.Overall:This grooming kit is a practical, well made set that includes everything needed for regular coat maintenance. The tools perform well, feel durable, and make grooming much easier. I would definitely recommend it.
authors_reviews.author: Byhellojess

authors_reviews.title: The ultimate grooming kit for long, thick double coats!
authors_reviews.text: I bought this 5-piece grooming kit as a gift for my mom, and it has completely transformed grooming day for her Pekingese. Because Peks have such thick, dense double coats, keeping up with tangles and loose undercoat can be a real chore, but this set has every tool needed to do the job right.The undercoat rake and slicker brush are absolute standouts—they effortlessly glide through heavy fur to remove dead hair and prevent mats without scratching sensitive skin. The metal comb is sturdy and perfect for fine-tuning around the face and featherings, and the bath brush makes shampoo lathering a breeze during bath time.The build quality feels solid and durable, not flimsy like a lot of pet store sets. My mom is thrilled with how easy it makes upkeep, and her pup looks like he just stepped out of a professional salon. Highly recommend to anyone with a long-haired or double-coated breed!
authors_reviews.author: Skye and Ted

authors_reviews.title: The one you need grooming kit
authors_reviews.text: I received the package slightly damaged but on opening everything up the items were not damaged. As a golden retriever owner I have been on the lookout for a quality slicker brush and decided to get this kit. Firstly, I would not recommend the metal brush for a golden as it gets caught in their hair and knots. Same goes for the fine brush. Those might be for smaller, thinner haired dogs. As for the slicker, you can see how much hair it collected from my dog!!! The de-shedding tool also worked great at removing the hair stuck in the undercoat. The silicone brush worked great as well although I would use that for brushing/scrubbing a double coated dog during a bath. Would highly recommend this kit for grooming a double coated dog like a golden
authors_reviews.author: CB_AB_SB

authors_reviews.title: All-in-one Comb Set! Quality Material!
authors_reviews.text: I was impressed with this grooming set! The set comes with 5 different types of combs. Each comb was individually wrapped. They arrived shiny with no scratches or scuffs. The color is a medium intensity. This set is aesthetically pleasing and doesn't look cheap. There are combs for the bath, daily grooming, undercoats, and fleas! Each comb has an ergonomically correct handle, and they are padded for comfort. This is really convenient because we have a german shepherd with a thick undercoat, and we deshed for long periods of time. The slicker has a good teeth length and the deshedder has sharp blades. Nothing feels flimsy about this product and the set will last for a while. Perfect for longer haired breed. I would highly recommend this product for value, quality, and price!
authors_reviews.author: J Reynolds

authors_reviews.title: Lots of tools
authors_reviews.text: This is a high quality grooming kit with a good selection of tools for the price. In particular, the metal comb is a nice large size with good spacing of teeth. The slicker brush's bristles are strong enough for tough fur but with enough give that knots aren't pulled uncomfortably. I hope that the flea comb isn't needed but the teeth are right spacing for tiny flea removal. My dog won't need the rake but it is also solid, not-too-heavy/not-too-light feel. I find the variety of tools in this set helpful for an overall start to grooming supplies
authors_reviews.author: Fun in the sun

authors_reviews.title: Worked Great!
authors_reviews.text: Got this for my dog Cooper and he loved the extra attention to his coat. He is a lab mix so he has no lack of fur to shed. We used primarily the slicker brush and the rake brush on him and it definitely removed a lot of excess fur. The tools worked great and they had a good quality feel to them as well. Definitely a great value for any dog owner!
authors_reviews.author: Jesse

authors_reviews.title: My Dog Actually Enjoys Grooming Now
authors_reviews.text: My dog normally gets impatient during brushing, but this set makes grooming much easier. The brush moves smoothly through his coat and helps remove loose fur without needing too much effort. I like having different tools for different steps — brushing, bathing, and finishing. It feels like having a small grooming station at home.
